key: ["In the land of seven rivers, poets compose hymns that will pass from memory to memory for centuries before anyone writes them down. One hymn names the rivers from the Ganga to the Kabul. Another sings of King Sudas, victor over ten kings on the Ravi. The hymns know cattle and clans. They describe no cities.", "sarvam:varun_en_suspense@en-IN", "+6%", "+0Hz", null, 1.0, 0.0, "v3"]
